# HT Complete Family Dentistry

> Family dentistry in Overland Park, Kansas. Pediatric, Invisalign, cosmetic, general, and preventative care for Lenexa, Overland Park, Leawood, and Kansas City.

HT Complete Family Dentistry is the practice of Sarina Harman-Tinnel, DDS.
